# Security & Local-First Sovereignty Checklist: Mika — AI Flow Copilot (Feature 048)

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality checklist validating the completeness, clarity, measurability, and consistency of security, privacy, Local-First sovereignty, and BYOK credential protection requirements for the Mika AI Copilot.  
**Created**: 2026-10-20  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Soberania Local-First & Isolamento Hermético de Rede

- [ ] CHK001 Is the exact boundary of zero-network isolation explicitly defined and bounded when the copilot operates in heuristic mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification define whether any background telemetry, telemetry ping, or model metadata lookups are allowed when offline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Can the requirement "zero vazamento de dados de tarefas para a rede" be objectively and deterministically verified via automated test fixtures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is an explicit user opt-in or confirmation step documented before the system transitions from heuristic mode to active network dispatch? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3, Gap]

## 2. Armazenamento Seguro e Ciclo de Vida de Credenciais (BYOK)

- [ ] CHK005 Is the credential obfuscation mechanism in `localStorage` specified with concrete expectations, clarifying whether it represents client-side obfuscation or encryption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements specified for handling corrupted, invalid, or externally tampered preference entries in `localStorage`? [Edge Cases, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification define the exact scope and immediate side effects of the "desconexão e limpeza em 1 clique" action across in-memory state and persistent storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is cache purging explicitly mandated when an API key is removed, updated, or when the operational provider is switched? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-009]

## 3. Máscara Visual & Prevenção de Exposição Casual de Chave

- [ ] CHK009 Is the visual masking pattern for API keys in the UI quantified with exact character counts and prefix rules (e.g., first 6 chars + fixed asterisks)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are reveal / unmask interactions for the API key intentionally specified with security guardrails or explicitly prohibited to prevent shoulder-surfing? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification prohibit displaying raw API keys in tooltips, title attributes, or system notifications? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## 4. Higienização de Payloads e Privacidade de Dados de Tarefas

- [ ] CHK012 Does the specification explicitly define the minimum required payload fields sent to external LLMs during task decomposition, excluding non-essential metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Are privacy guidelines or sanitization requirements documented for sensitive user comments and attachment descriptions prior to external AI requests? [Privacy, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are content sanitization or injection mitigation requirements defined for AI-generated subtask suggestions before insertion into task checklists? [Security, Gap]

## 5. Resiliência de Rede, Fallbacks e Tratamento Seguro de Erros

- [ ] CHK015 Are failure handling requirements defined for network timeouts, HTTP 401/403 (invalid key), and HTTP 429 (rate limits)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the fallback to the local heuristic engine required to be transparent and non-blocking without exposing sensitive stack traces or API keys in UI alerts? [Resilience, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the specification strictly forbid writing raw API request/response payloads or keys to browser `console.log` streams in production builds? [Security, Gap]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied in `spec.md` or companion design documents.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when requirements still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and must not modify reviewer markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add reviewer findings, notes, or cross-references inline as evaluation progresses.
